title: Build disk space on Vercel increased to 64 GB
summary_en: Disk space for Vercel builds has increased from 32 GB to 64 GB on Basic and Standard machines, matching the capacity already available on Enhanced and Turbo. The additional space provides more room for the packages your project uses and the files generated during a build, reducing the risk of running out of disk space. The change applies automatically across all plans and build machine types at no additional charge, with no configuration changes required. Learn more in the build machine documentation . Read more
